answers.core: Adding it as a plugin wouldn't solve the problem, since few people actually use/search for plugins on Godot. What I developed solves a real problem for mobile games; simply adding it as a plugin wouldn't change anything, as it would remain hidden from the community.
answers.workaround: Not in the way I developed it, because it would have to simulate an input and wouldn't support gestures or touchpad in the same way I did it.
